author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Update the environment variable `OMPI_MCA_accelerator` based on the accelerator framework selected by CMSSW:
  - if the variable is `null`, set it to `cuda` or `rocm` based on what accelerator is enabled;
  - if the variable contains `cuda` or `rocm`, remove those entries if the corresponding accelerator is disabled, and set the variable to `null` if the result would be empty.

The result should be that if the variable was set to `null`, it gets set to the accelerator that is selected by CMSSW: `cuda`, `rocm`, or `null`.

If the variable was set to some other value, like `cuda,rocm,null`, only the accelerator that are disabled will be removed from the list.

For more background information see the discussions at https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/49332#issuecomment-3517942589 and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50503#pullrequestreview-4968664921 .

#### PR validation:

None.
title: Make Open MPI 5 use the same accelerator as CMSSW
